messages:
maya: Heads-up — localization flagged several issues in the Optimize toolkit docs for batching/caching/quantization. Most examples expect en-US number/currency formats and English-only prompts. We need a short plan to make snippets locale-aware and avoid broken translations.

liam: Can you paste a couple of examples that failed? I can update the SDK snippets to use Intl where needed.

maya: Sure — translation QA found: 1) `1,234.56 tokens/s` rendered oddly in de/ru/zh builds; 2) currency example `$0.012` should be localized or shown as a conversion helper; 3) some variable names include English-only comments that confuse translators.

sophie: I saw the zh-CN artifacts — link anchors broke because we injected localized headings that changed slugs. We should avoid relying on English headings for cross-page links.

liam: Plan suggestion: (a) change numeric literals in examples to call `Intl.NumberFormat(locale)` in the snippets, (b) add a small helper snippet for formatting cost/tokens for docs consumers, (c) keep link anchors stable by using explicit `id=` attributes in the markdown.

alex: +1. Also add an examples matrix: en-US, de-DE, es-ES, zh-CN — short table with the same sample prompt translated and the formatted numbers. That'll help translators and reviewers.

maya: Good. Who can open the PR? We should coordinate with translations and add a CI smoke test to render the localized pages. @sophie? :eyes:

sophie: I can open the PR and drop a checklist. Will need one snippet owner to make the code changes (liam?), and someone to add the smoke test (alex?).

liam: I'll update snippets. Quick draft (Node SDK) to include in PR — uses Intl and keeps the Optimize config identical:

```js
// locale-aware formatting for docs examples
const locale = 'de-DE'; // replaced by translation pipeline per build
const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { maximumFractionDigits: 3 });
const tokensPerSec = 1234.567;
console.log(`Throughput: ${nf.format(tokensPerSec)} tokens/s`);
// quant profile example stays the same; only presentation changes
const quantProfile = {
  name: 'q2_k_v1',
  bits: 2,
  note: 'Quantization is orthogonal to formatting; values below are model params.'
};
```

liam: I'll also add a short Python snippet using `format(locale)` in docs examples.

docs-bot: PR created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — "i18n: locale-aware examples for optimize toolkit" (assigns: sophie, liam, alex).

alex: For CI: I'll add a smoke render job that runs the static build for en/de/zh and checks that required anchors exist and that the examples include an `Intl` or equivalent formatting call. Will push a small pipeline change after the PR lands.

maya: Timeline: PR by EOD today for initial snippets, translation team will stage translations next week, CI smoke in follow-up PR. Also add a short note in the migration guide advising consumers how to parse numbers in different locales when reading our docs.

sophie: Opening PR now and adding the checklist in the description. Will ping translations and engineering doc reviewers. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: docs deploy queued for next stable window after PR merge.

maya: Thanks team — keep updates in this thread and tag me if translations block anything.
